name: Windows-MCP-Pro
description: Coding-agent MCP server for Windows: shell, files, code search and web research
long_description:
Windows-MCP Pro is a fork of CursorTouch/Windows-MCP v0.8.5, aimed at coding agents instead of GUI automation.

**WHAT IS DIFFERENT**
- **13 tools, not 23.** The eleven GUI tools (Snapshot, Screenshot, Click, Type, Scroll, Move, Shortcut, MultiSelect, MultiEdit, DisplayInventory, WaitFor) were removed: their schemas cost roughly 14,000 characters of context on every request and a coding agent never calls them.
- **Coding tools.** Surgical Edit (replace, regex, line ranges, patches, sha256 guards, backups), Grep (grep / map / outline), Job for background processes with logs, and persistent PowerShell sessions.
- **SearchPro replaces Scrape.** Metasearch across Brave, Yandex, DuckDuckGo, Bing and Yahoo, plus article extraction, CSS scraping and a headless crawler - running out of process so its dependencies cannot break the server.
- **Hardened.** Timeouts clamped below the ~60s client abort, bounded tool output, CLIXML stderr decoding, and SSRF-checked fetch targets.

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**
- **Python 3.14+**
- **Windows 10 or 11**

anonymized_telemetry.title: Anonymized Telemetry
anonymized_telemetry.description: Collects basic usage data to help improve the MCP server. No personal information, tool arguments, or tool outputs are tracked.

search_python.title: SearchPro Interpreter
search_python.description: Optional full path to a Python interpreter that has the search stack installed (ddgs, trafilatura, scrapling, crawl4ai). Leave empty to auto-discover, then run SearchPro with mode=env to see what was found.

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Enable debug mode to provide verbose logging for troubleshooting.

watchdog.title: UIA Focus WatchDog
watchdog.description: Run the UIAutomation focus watchdog. Off by default: it currently only emits debug logging, while costing a background thread and a UIA event subscription that can crash the server on unstable UIA environments. Tool behaviour is unaffected either way.

tools.name: PowerShell
tools.description: Runs a PowerShell command and returns stdout, stderr and the exit code. Supports a working directory, a persistent named session that keeps variables and the current directory between calls, and a timeout clamped to 55s because MCP clients abort a call at around 60s. Use Job for anything longer.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description: Surgical file editing. mode=apply runs a list of edits (replace, regex, lines, delete_lines, insert_after, insert_before, append, prepend, create, patch) with optional sha256 guards, dry runs and automatic backups. mode=view prints a numbered slice of a file.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description: Code search over a directory tree. mode=grep finds regex or literal matches with context, mode=map gives a file and directory overview, mode=outline lists the symbols of a single file. Output is capped so a wide pattern cannot flood the context window.

tools.name: Job
tools.description: Runs long commands in the background: mode=start, status, logs (tail, head or pattern), stop, list, clean. Use this for builds, test suites and installs instead of a blocking shell call.

tools.name: FileSystem
tools.description: File and folder operations: read, write, copy, move, delete, list, search, info.

tools.name: Git
tools.description: Git for a local repository: mode=status groups changed files by stage, mode=diff prints a --stat summary plus a trimmed patch, mode=log lists recent commits, mode=commit stages and commits (reusing the last commit's author when the machine has no git identity), mode=branch lists or switches branches, mode=info reports the current repository, its remotes, whether the GitHub CLI is logged in, and other repositories nearby. Push, reset and rebase are deliberately not exposed.

tools.name: SearchPro
tools.description: Web research in one tool. mode=search, news, images and videos metasearch through ddgs (Brave, Yandex, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Yahoo). mode=read extracts an article as clean text, mode=select scrapes CSS selectors, mode=crawl drives a headless browser for JavaScript pages, mode=env diagnoses the search stack. Runs out of process, budgets its output, and refuses private or non-HTTP fetch targets.

tools.name: App
tools.description: Launches, switches and resizes Windows applications.

tools.name: Process
tools.description: Lists running processes or kills one by pid or name.

tools.name: Registry
tools.description: Accesses the Windows Registry: mode=get reads a value, mode=set creates or updates a value, mode=delete removes a value or key, mode=list lists values and sub-keys under a path.

tools.name: Clipboard
tools.description: Reads from or writes to the Windows clipboard.

tools.name: Notification
tools.description: Sends a Windows toast notification with a title and message.

tools.name: Wait
tools.description: Pauses for a given number of seconds, clamped to 45s, when something outside the agent control needs a moment to settle.
